text:
Situation: Rifampin injection has been on FDA's shortage list since 2021-02-17 and remains Current as of 2026-10-21. The listing includes Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC, Mylan Institutional (a Viatris Company), and Sanofi-Aventis U.S. LLC. Our Corvale sites hold the Mylan Institutional product (NDC 67457-445-60) manufactured at OneSource Specialty Pharma Limited in Bengaluru. Corvale East has only 4.4 days of the 600 mg/10 mL 10 mL vial on hand; Corvale Lakeside holds 29.5 days and Corvale General holds 15.8 days of the same presentation.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspected Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) on 2020-05-18 and classified it OAI, with the classification letter issued 2024-05-22. A second inspection ending 2022-06-30 was also classified OAI, with the letter dated 2024-04-30. FDA's shortage posting for rifampin injection remains Current as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: We have sufficient supply at Corvale Lakeside and Corvale General to support an internal transfer that protects Corvale East without dropping other sites below two weeks on hand. No clinical changes are proposed; any formulary or dosing decisions remain with the treating clinicians and the committee.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 17 vials of rifampin 600 mg/10 mL 10 mL vial from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East. Approval required: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
2. If additional supply is needed, transfer 7 vials of the same presentation from Corvale General to Corvale East. Approval required: Pharmacy Director (transfer request).
3. Evaluate purchase from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. for future needs. Approval required: Buyer.

Not recommended: Switching to alternate concentrations or vial sizes (options 4 and 5) at this time because internal transfer resolves the immediate gap and those alternatives require pharmacist recalculation and verification without adding supply.
